**First beta of HMG-API**, the mod manager for Hyundai, Kia and Genesis Gen5W navigation head units. It's for owners who are happy to test and report back.

## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `hmgapi-1.0.0-beta.1-usb.zip` | Install from a USB stick, no computer needed (Engineering Mode → USB Copy → DSP → Update OTA, or NEMESIS's USB install). Includes the mods below. |
| `hmgapi-1.0.0-beta.1-nemesis.zip` | Install from NEMESIS Manager. |
| `hmgapi-1.0.0-beta.1-adb.zip` | Install from a computer over adb. |
| `hmgapi-1.0.0-beta.1-update.zip` | Update an installed HMG-API (put it in `HMGAPI/updates/` on a stick, then Check USB updates in the app). |
| `wireless-carplay-aa-2.1.0.zip`, `adb-1.0.0.zip`, `nemesis-shortcut-1.1.0.zip` | The mods, on their own. |
| `SHA256SUMS` | Checksums. |

Step-by-step instructions: [Installing HMG-API](https://github.com/VysseCodes/HMG-API/wiki/Installing-HMG-API). Uninstalling puts every file back exactly as it was.

## What works

Tested on a **2023 Kia EV6, US, head unit software 260507**:

- The HMG-API app: mods with their state, settings and logs, HMG-API's settings, the Car Report and logs.
- Mods: install, switch on and off, settings, remove.
- Wireless Android Auto with turn-by-turn on the cluster and HUD (seen parked).
- Steering wheel and head unit buttons for mods, side panel pages, Android Auto events.
- The Car Report: maps your car from its own software and makes a report to send in.

## Not tested yet

- CarPlay with this version.
- Installing from a USB stick or NEMESIS on a car that has never had adb on (our test car was installed over adb).
- Any car other than the US EV6. HMG-API runs on other Gen5W navigation cars, but mods that change the car's own apps need your car's hook map. **Please make a Car Report** (HMG-API app → Car Report) and send it: the QR code opens a filled-in issue.

## Known issues

- The head unit has to restart after installing, and after turning a mod with code on or off. The app says when.
- After a long drive (a full power-off), adb over USB once didn't come back until the head unit was restarted.
- A USB stick left in the port can start wired Android Auto and stop wireless from connecting. Take the stick out after installing.

## Reporting

[Open an issue](https://github.com/VysseCodes/HMG-API/issues/new/choose) and attach a Car Report. Please don't post your VIN, serial numbers or phone numbers; nothing needs them.
